title: HBM demand and premium mix drive profitability
thesis: AI workloads support HBM demand; if MU monetizes this demand through a richer product mix, revenue quality and gross margin could improve.
supporting_evidence: HBM demand and MU disclosed HBM shipments/revenue or mix improve together
MU gross margin improves with consistent reporting basis
challenging_evidence: HBM industry demand grows but MU HBM revenue/mix does not respond
MU gross margin declines despite favorable memory pricing
disconfirmation: HBM industry demand grows but MU HBM revenue/mix does not respond
metrics: HBM revenue or mix, if disclosed
known_confounds: HBM strength may coincide with rising manufacturing or packaging costs
Gross margin is affected by multiple products and accounting factors

title: Memory supply cycle threatens pricing power
thesis: Excess DRAM supply or inventory normalization could weaken pricing and offset earnings recovery.
supporting_evidence: Bit supply and inventories rise while DRAM ASP and MU gross margin weaken
challenging_evidence: DRAM ASP remains strong despite new capacity
Company product mix offsets pricing declines
disconfirmation: DRAM ASP remains strong despite new capacity
known_confounds: Capacity announcements do not equal realized wafer output
Technology mix and timing can offset headline capacity

title: AI infrastructure spending sustains accelerator demand
thesis: Sustained AI infrastructure investment could support accelerator demand and NVIDIA data center revenue.
supporting_evidence: AI infrastructure spending and accelerator order indicators grow
NVIDIA data center revenue confirms demand conversion
challenging_evidence: Capex grows but is allocated to non-GPU infrastructure or competitors
Orders fail to convert into reported sales
disconfirmation: Capex grows but is allocated to non-GPU infrastructure or competitors
known_confounds: AI capex does not translate one-to-one to NVIDIA revenue
Export mix and inventory channel matter

title: Supply and export constraints limit growth
thesis: Packaging/memory capacity constraints and export rules could restrict NVIDIA shipments or addressable sales.
supporting_evidence: Supply-related disclosure confirms restrictions or delivery delays
New applicable export restrictions reduce accessible end markets
challenging_evidence: Capacity expands and shipment constraints ease
Demand redirects to approved products/markets with demonstrated conversion
disconfirmation: Capacity expands and shipment constraints ease
known_confounds: Committed supply is not shipped supply
Regulatory headlines may not affect named product/market

title: Instinct adoption drives AI accelerator revenue expansion
thesis: Customer adoption of AMD Instinct accelerators could increase accelerator shipments and data center sales.
supporting_evidence: Customer deployment translates to disclosed accelerator shipments or revenue
Data center revenue and profitability improve with accelerators
challenging_evidence: Announced deployments are delayed or not monetized
Growth is primarily CPU rather than Instinct and thesis is misattributed
disconfirmation: Announced deployments are delayed or not monetized
known_confounds: Customer announcements may not imply contracted revenue
Data center includes CPUs and accelerators

title: EPYC adoption improves data center economics
thesis: EPYC server CPU adoption could support AMD data center growth and segment economics.
supporting_evidence: Server CPU deployment and reported AMD data center economics advance
challenging_evidence: CPU adoption stalls
Segment growth comes from other product categories or margin worsens
known_confounds: Data center metric aggregates product lines
Competitor market share numbers need independent verification

title: AI server orders convert into profitable revenue
thesis: Growth in AI-server orders and backlog could convert to revenue and profitable ISG operating performance.
supporting_evidence: Backlog converts to reported revenue and ISG profitability
Revenue and cash conversion improve without excessive working capital
challenging_evidence: Backlog increases but conversion is delayed
AI server revenue grows with deteriorating ISG margin or cash conversion
disconfirmation: Backlog increases but conversion is delayed
known_confounds: Order book may be cancelable or time-shifted
Large lower-margin server mix can depress group margin

title: Component inflation compresses infrastructure margins
thesis: Rising DRAM/NAND and other component prices could pressure Dell margins unless selling prices and configuration mix offset the costs.
supporting_evidence: Input costs rise while ISG margins deteriorate
challenging_evidence: Dell increases realized pricing and maintains margins
Supplier rebates or mix reduce net cost pressure
disconfirmation: Dell increases realized pricing and maintains margins
known_confounds: Component cost contracts can lag spot prices
DRAM/NAND pricing is only part of BOM

title: NAND pricing recovery supports earnings
thesis: NAND ASP recovery and supply discipline could improve Sandisk revenue mix and gross margin.
supporting_evidence: NAND ASP recovers and SNDK revenue/margin confirms pass-through
Inventory tightness is corroborated by supplier data
challenging_evidence: NAND ASP improves but SNDK margin/cash does not
Bit supply expands faster than demand
disconfirmation: NAND ASP improves but SNDK margin/cash does not
known_confounds: SNDK fiscal comparability around WDC separation
Segment/customer contracts may lag NAND spot price

title: Enterprise SSD demand expands higher-value mix
thesis: Growing enterprise SSD adoption could improve Sandisk demand mix and long-term unit economics if monetized.
supporting_evidence: Enterprise SSD orders convert into shipments and improving mix
challenging_evidence: Market demand rises but SNDK share or economics do not
Enterprise SSD growth is offset by falling overall NAND pricing
disconfirmation: Market demand rises but SNDK share or economics do not
known_confounds: Do not equate general AI data center capex with Sandisk-specific business
Do not merge WDC HDD with SNDK NAND
